idea: Precompute, by multi-start penalty optimisation with rotation, the best packings of m=2..6 squares in rectangles of aspect 1:1, 2:1, 3:2 and 3:1. Use them as tiles that replace equal-aspect blocks of grid cells, inserted through the existing replacement and knapsack machinery when their scaled (Δcount, Δsum) beats the axis-aligned retilings.
